title: Z-Parameters Amplifier
text: Model nonlinear amplifier using Z-parameters, {Interpolation method} sets Method to interpolate network parameters; {Z-Parameters} sets the z-parameters for nonlinear amplifier, {Frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency of Z-parameters 2.0e9, {Noise type} sets the type of noise data, {Noise figure (dB)} sets the available signal-to-noise ratio at the input to available signal-to-noise ratio, {Minimum noise figure} sets the minimum ratio of available signal-to-noise ratio at input to available signal-to-noise ratio, {Optimal reflection coefficient} sets the optimal source impedance, {Equivalent normalized noise resistance} sets the normalized resistance values used to take noise, {Noise factor} sets the ratio of available signal-to-noise power at input to available signal-to-noise power, {Noise temperature (K)} sets the equivalent temperature that produces the same amount of noise, {IP3 type} sets the type of third order, {IP3 (dBm)} sets the iP3 value, {1dB gain compression power (dBm)} sets the output power value at which gain has decreased by 1 dB, {Output saturation power (dBm)} sets the output power value that amplifier produces when fully saturated, {Gain compression at saturation (dB)} sets the decrease in gain value, {Source of frequency data} sets the frequency data source Same, {Frequency data (Hz)} sets the frequency data range, {Reference impedance (ohms)}, {Plot type} sets the type of data plot, {Y parameter1} sets the type of parameters, {Y parameter2} sets the type of parameters, {Y format1} plots format Magnitude, {Y format2} plots format Magnitude, {X parameter} sets the frequency plot, {X format} sets the frequency plot format, {Y scale} sets the y-axis scale, {X scale} sets the x-axis scale and {Plot}. Values come from the instance.
